description: NAYA-NEUTRALITY-PROFILE-V1 (2026-10-11, Zero Value Law Part 2). A versioned, domain-specific tolerance for 'practically neutral' verdicts. NOT a universal setting. A PRACTICALLY_NEUTRAL verdict is valid only against an approved profile whose neutral zone, provenance, and protections are all satisfied. This is distinct from V2.1's interval_epsilon, which governs candidate interval-dominance in selection, not neutral-value tolerance.

affected_parties.description: Factor 2: whose benefit/harm, including vulnerable groups. Each materially affected group is assessed independently (protection 2: no aggregate laundering).

approval.description: Factor 8: who approved the threshold, using which evidence and policy version? (protection 5: no threshold manipulation).

domain.description: The bounded domain this profile governs. Profiles are domain-specific, never universal.

evidence_quality.description: Factor 7: is measurement precise enough to distinguish neutrality from uncertainty? If the instrument cannot detect the smallest meaningful effect, the verdict is NEEDS_EVIDENCE, not neutral (falsifier 7).

meaningful_effect_threshold.description: Factor 3: smallest change affected parties would care about. Justifies epsilon.

neutral_zone.description: The asymmetric neutral zone [-epsilon_neg, +epsilon_pos]. PRACTICALLY_NEUTRAL requires the ENTIRE uncertainty interval [L, U] inside this zone: L >= -epsilon_neg AND U <= epsilon_pos.

epsilon_neg.description: Magnitude of the negative tolerance bound.

epsilon_pos.description: Magnitude of the positive tolerance bound.

observation_horizon.description: Factor 6: when would delayed benefits/harms become visible? (protection 4: no delayed-harm laundering).

outcome_metric.description: Factor 1: what exactly is measured, in what units?

profile_id.description: Stable identifier for this neutrality profile.

profile_version.description: Version string. Thresholds are approved BEFORE outcome review; changing a threshold cannot silently reclassify historical results (protection 5).

protected_boundaries.description: Factor 4: legal/privacy/consent/safety/rights prohibitions that apply regardless of effect size (protection 1: hard boundaries first).

scale_and_accumulation.description: Factor 5: could tiny per-event change become significant across users/repetitions? (protection 3: no cumulative laundering).

title: NayaNET Neutrality Profile V1
